# Steam Deck Web App Generator

> A free web app that generates a bash script which adds any website or web app to Steam Deck Game Mode as a non-Steam game, opened in Chrome kiosk mode. Built with Nuxt.

Enter an app name and a URL, download the generated .sh file, then in Desktop Mode run `chmod +x` on it and execute it once. It needs the flatpak version of Google Chrome on the Steam Deck and creates the launcher in ~/Documents unless told otherwise. The app name becomes the launcher file name, so it cannot contain a slash.

## Docs

- [Generator](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/): create and download the shortcut script
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/steam-deck-web-app-generator/blob/main/README.md): installation steps, requirements and screenshots

## Guides

- [All guides](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides): index of the Steam Deck Game Mode guides
- [YouTube on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-youtube): add youtube.com to Game Mode as a Chrome shortcut
- [Netflix on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-netflix): Netflix shortcut setup and Netflix's own notes on Chrome for Linux
- [Xbox Cloud Gaming for Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-xbox-cloud-gaming): Microsoft's Edge setup and the Chrome shortcut alternative
- [GeForce NOW on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-geforce-now): NVIDIA's Steam Deck app first, a browser shortcut as fallback
- [Web browser in Game Mode](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-web-browser): add Chrome itself or a single site to the library
- [Add non-Steam games to Steam and Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/add-non-steam-game): Valve's steps for the Steam client and for Steam Deck, and how the generator adds a website as one
- [Install Chrome on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/install-chrome-steam-deck): Chrome from Discover, adding it to Game Mode, then per-site shortcuts
- [Steam Deck Desktop Mode](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-desktop-mode): switch to the desktop and back, controls, installing apps with Discover and running them in Game Mode
- [Discord on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-discord): the Discord flatpak or discord.com in Chrome, voice chat while gaming and the microphone notes Valve documents
- [Spotify on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-spotify): the Spotify flatpak or the web player in Chrome, and music while you play
- [Steam Deck sudo password](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-sudo-password): no default password, setting one with passwd, and what Valve offers if it is forgotten
- [Open the terminal on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steam-deck-terminal): Konsole in Desktop Mode, typing with STEAM + X and running a .sh file
- [SteamGridDB artwork on Steam Deck](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/guides/steamgriddb-steam-deck): custom artwork for non-Steam shortcuts with SGDBoop or the Decky Loader plugin
- [Steam Deck shortcuts](https://steam-deck-web-app-generator.vercel.app/steam-deck-shortcuts): printable cheat sheet of the button combos and desktop controls Valve documents
